pages.name: Landing Page
pages.hero_instructions: Large h1, glowing primary CTA button, hero image showing entrepreneur laptop on right side, ambient dark background with subtle grid overlay.

media_mapping.hero_background: CSS generated radial gradient with #1ed760 glow and #09090b background

pages.name: Analysis Form Page
pages.instructions: Clean, distraction-free inputs. Inputs must have #27272a borders, text white. 'Analyze' button pulses slightly. Label color #a1a1aa.

pages.name: Results Dashboard
pages.instructions: Top row: Summary cards (col-span-1 or 2). Next: Recharts Bar Chart (col-span-full). Bottom: 2 columns (High Demand / Low Demand). Right or Bottom: 3 Action Cards.
pages.chart_styling: Recharts: Use #1ed760 for high demand bars, #ef4444 for low demand. Grid lines must be #27272a (very subtle). Tooltips must have bg-[#18181b] and border-[#27272a].

pages.name: Upgrade Modal
pages.instructions: Use Shadcn Dialog. Backdrop blur xl. Highlight 3/3 free analyses used in red. Primary action 'Upgrade to Pro' in #1ed760.

accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure text-secondary (#a1a1aa) against surface (#18181b) meets 4.5:1 WCAG.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='analyze-submit-btn')

hero_context_image.description: Person using Macbook Pro on white table, representing an e-commerce store owner
hero_context_image.placement: Landing page hero section right side
